response:
People who fill out a **subscribe form** are normally added to your contacts with a **Subscriber** label. A few things can explain mixed statuses:

- **Double opt-in:** if it's enabled on the form, people must **verify their email** before they're subscribed. Anyone who hasn't clicked the confirmation link won't show as subscribed yet.
- **They unsubscribed later:** subscribers can unsubscribe from your emails (e.g. via the unsubscribe link in a campaign), which changes their status.
- **Not a subscribe form:** other forms only subscribe people if the form includes a **subscribe to mailing list** field and they tick it.

The articles I have don't list every subscription status, so if a specific contact looks wrong I can connect you with a support agent.

You can transfer a site to another Wix account:

1. Go to your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Site Actions** icon at the top → **Transfer site**.
3. Enter the new owner's Wix account email.
4. For a **Premium** site, choose what to include: **Transfer site plan**, **Transfer domain & business email**, and premium apps (these transfer automatically).
5. Choose whether to **keep your role as Co-Owner** and whether to **keep a copy** of the site.
6. Click **Continue**, review the summary, tick the confirmation box and click **Transfer Ownership**.

The new owner must accept the email invite within **3 days**. After the transfer, they manage all future payments.

Note: a free site's URL changes after transfer. If you just need someone to work on the site, add them as a **collaborator** instead.

Your domain must be assigned to the site that has the active Premium plan:

1. Go to **Domains** in your Wix account.
2. Next to the domain, click **Assign** (if it says *Not Assigned to a Site*), or use **Domain Actions → Assign to a Different Site**.
3. Select the upgraded site and click **Next**.
4. If that site already has a domain, choose **Replace the current primary domain** or **Redirect it to the primary domain**.
5. Click **Assign**.

Also check that the plan's status is **Active** in **Premium Subscriptions**. If the plan is on the wrong site, move it with **More Actions → Assign to a Different Site**. If the domain is connected via name servers, make sure your domain host uses the Wix name servers.

This is usually caused by **browser autoplay rules**, not your sound setting:

- Videos set to **autoplay always start muted**. Most browsers (Safari 11+, Chrome 61+, Firefox 66+) only allow autoplay when the sound is off. Visitors need to **click/unmute** the video to hear it, or change their own browser settings.
- On **mobile**, Apple and Chrome may block autoplay entirely, and iOS low-power mode disables it.

If you want sound to play, turn off **Autoplay on load** (Wix Video → **Settings** → **Player** tab) so visitors start the video themselves. For videos in **Wix Blog** posts, check that **Play with sound** is enabled in the blog's **Video Settings**.

Which payment information do you want to update?

**The card you pay Wix with (plans, domains, email):**
1. Go to **Payment Methods** in your Wix account.
2. Click **Actions** → **Update** → **Next**.
3. Update your card details and click **Update**. Changes apply to all subscriptions using that method.

(If a renewal failed, you can also click **Update Payment Method** on the subscription in **Premium Subscriptions**.)

**Your Wix Payments details (where you get paid):** go to **Accept Payments** → **Manage** next to Wix Payments → **Edit Account Details**, edit and **Save**/**Resubmit**. Payouts pause while the change is verified (up to 7 business days).

**Invoice details (name, address, VAT ID):** **Billing History** → **More Actions** → **Update invoice details**.

You can show visitors your desktop layout on mobile by turning off the **mobile-friendly view**:

1. In the editor, click **Settings** in the top bar.
2. Click **Mobile Friendly**.
3. Turn the toggle **off** and click **Close**.

We **don't recommend** this: desktop pages load more slowly on phones, visitors may not see all content, it can hurt your **SEO**, and Wix doesn't provide support for issues when showing the desktop view on mobile.

A better option is to keep the mobile view and adjust it in the **mobile editor** (rearrange elements, use the **Page Layout Optimizer**, adjust page height) so it closely matches your desktop design.

If you mean what Google shows for your page in **search results**, that comes from the page's **title tag** and **meta description**:

1. In the editor, click **Pages & Menu** → **More Actions** next to the page → **SEO basics**.
2. Edit the **Title tag** (and the meta description), then **publish** your site.
3. To speed up the update, request a **recrawl** of the page in **Google Search Console**.

Note: search engines treat these as a guide. They may show different text if they think other content on the page fits the search better, or if your title/description doesn't meet their guidelines.

Removing a seat is a two-step process.

**Step 1: Delete the user in Google Workspace**
1. Go to **Business Email** in your Wix account → **More Actions** next to the email → **Manage at Google**.
2. Sign in, then in the Admin console go to **Directory → Users**.
3. Click **Remove user** (or **Delete user**) for the person and confirm. If they're an admin, revoke Admin status first.

**Step 2: Update billing**
- **Monthly subscription:** go to **Premium Subscriptions** → **More Actions** next to the business email → **Remove users**, tick **I want to delete my inactive Business Emails** and click **Reduce Subscription**. (Subscriptions with unpaid invoices can't be reduced.)
- **Yearly subscription:** contact **Wix Customer Care** after Step 1, and they'll update billing so you're only charged for the remaining emails.

To report copyright infringement by a Wix user, fill out Wix's **DMCA Copyright Complaint Form**. It's the fastest way to report it. Wix responds to clear notices that meet the requirements of the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA).

If you want to protect your own content in future, you can add the **Right Click Protect** app or display images in a **Pro Gallery**, which blocks right-click saving on desktop.
